mission_prompt: Ingest uploaded government cloud migration RFP, extract mandatory technical compliance criteria, model multi-tier labor pricing, and generate a winning executive proposal with compliance traceability matrix.

units.description: Read the uploaded government cloud migration RFP file (PDF/Word), extract all textual content, and convert it into a structured JSON representation with sections, subsections, and paragraph text for downstream processing.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [None - Initial Branch Node]
units.output_contract: A JSON object containing the full RFP text organized by logical sections (e.g., Scope, Technical Requirements, Evaluation Criteria).

units.description: Parse the structured RFP JSON to identify all mandatory technical compliance items (e.g., security controls, data residency, audit requirements). Produce a list of criteria with identifiers and brief descriptions.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t1]
units.output_contract: A table or list of mandatory technical compliance criteria extracted from the RFP.

units.description: Using the extracted compliance criteria and typical cloud migration labor roles (e.g., Cloud Architect, Security Engineer, Project Manager), create a tiered pricing model (e.g., Standard, Premium, Enterprise) with hourly rates, estimated effort per role, and total cost per tier.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t2]
units.output_contract: A structured pricing table showing labor tiers, roles, hours, rates, and subtotal/total costs.

units.task_name: Generate Executive Proposal with Compliance Traceability Matrix
units.description: Synthesize a polished executive proposal document that includes: an executive summary, solution overview, labor pricing model, and a compliance traceability matrix mapping each mandatory technical criterion to the specific solution component or service that satisfies it. Format the output as a structured JSON suitable for conversion to PDF/Word.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t3]
units.output_contract: A complete proposal in JSON format with sections, bullet points, and a traceability matrix table linking criteria IDs to solution elements.

dag.goal: Create a comprehensive executive proposal for a government cloud migration RFP that includes extracted mandatory technical compliance criteria, a multi‑tier labor pricing model, and a compliance traceability matrix linking each requirement to the proposed solution.
dag.reasoning: The user requests ingestion of an uploaded document, extraction of specific content, modeling of pricing tiers, and synthesis of a proposal with traceability. This requires sequential phases: ingest & structure the RFP, extract compliance criteria, model labor costs, then generate the final deliverable. Each phase is atomic and can be executed by agents equipped with data analysis, code execution, and general reasoning skills.
